uncertainties: Body posture, coat, sex assignment of the restored living individual and soft tissues are reconstruction choices. Horn-bearing adult form chosen to preserve original scope.
UF16154 is not the horned skull. Do not claim its missing horns prove damage or sex; it only calibrates approximate cranial size.
Museum painting is a curated artistic reconstruction, not direct evidence of coat colors or exact body dimensions.
Horn surface coverage and details not scientifically resolved here; restrained smooth material without decorative rings.
